item.title: The riverine land-to-ocean carbon flux
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00834-7

Globally, rivers export ~1015 grams of carbon to the ocean each year. This Review explores the mobilization, modulation and transport of different species of carbon within watersheds and rivers, with the aim to help inform and improve land-to-ocean carbon flux estimates.
